subject: Urgent: P95 spike & increased 5xx after v5.1 + quant rollout
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@veridianhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden P95 spike & 5xx errors after today's model/quant deploy

Hi Irene,

We pushed your v5.1 model + new quant profile to production this morning (09:00 PST) and immediately saw P95 latency jump from ~220ms to ~1.8s and a sustained 5xx error rate (approx 1.8% of requests) for our inference traffic. Throughput dropped ~35% and our queue backlog grew — our dashboard is red.

Attached a small sample payload and a compressed set of logs from the 09:00-10:30 window (logs_snapshot.tar.gz, example_payload.json). The errors are decoder stalls and a lot of client-side timeouts. This is impacting our support SLAs and key flows for clinicians.

We need an immediate rollback to the prior model/profile or a hotfix. Please advise ASAP — if there’s a short mitigation window we can hold traffic back at our side, but we’d prefer Redwood rollback if it’s safer. Also expect this to be escalated to our CTO if not resolved quickly.

Thanks,
Liam
SRE Lead, Veridian Health
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 spike & 5xx errors after today's model/quant deploy

Hi Liam — thanks for the fast heads-up and the artifacts. I’ve kicked off an immediate triage and booked a 10:00 PST bridge with our on-call infra and inference teams.

High-level plan:
- Marissa will run a quick profile to verify whether the new quant profile (q5-uint8) is the root cause.
- If q5 is the issue, we will either revert to q4-int8 or roll back to v5.0 depending on which is safer for correctness.
- I’ll coordinate rollback windows and customer notice.

I’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth. For transparency: INC-9821 created and I’ve attached the runbook excerpt we’ll follow. Bridge details: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-9821

--
Irene Choi
Principal Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Liam Carter <liam.carter@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 spike & 5xx errors after today's model/quant deploy

On Fri, Dec 11, 2026 at 9:25 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the fast heads-up and the artifacts. I’ve kicked off an immediate triage...

Quick update from infra/profiling: the new quant profile (q5-uint8) appears to reduce model memory headroom at runtime and causes more frequent KV-cache invalidations for long-context requests. That combination is producing decode stalls that propagate as 5xx errors under bursty traffic. We reproduced the p95 spike on a small replay locally.

Immediate recommendations:
1) Schedule an emergency rollback of the quant profile to q4-int8 for Veridian’s pool. This is the fastest, lowest-risk mitigation and preserves v5.1 weights while restoring prior runtime behavior.
2) If you need model-level rollback, fallback to v5.0; that’s slightly more disruptive but safe.
3) Post-rollback: we’ll run an extended replay and produce a profiling_summary (attached) and a mitigations PR for the quant calibration pipeline.

I’ve attached profiling_summary.pdf with heap/latency comparisons. I’ll be on the bridge and can enact the rollback once ops gives the green light.

—Marissa
Senior Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sudden P95 spike & 5xx errors after today's model/quant deploy

Looping in Naomi for exec visibility and sign-off on customer credits / rollback. Veridian is a strategic account (D-67412) and this is causing live clinician impact.

Options for exec decision:
- Immediate rollback of quant profile (q5 -> q4) for Veridian only (recommended) — minimal risk.
- Customer-facing compensation: propose 25% credit for the affected day plus a follow-up technical postmortem and dedicated review call.
- Broader communication: evaluate whether other customers saw similar signals; if yes, consider a coordinated rollback of the q5 rollout.

We need Naomi’s go/no-go on the financial ask and whether we should pause the q5 rollout across other canaries until root cause mitigation is in place.

—Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 23:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden P95 spike & 5xx errors after today's model/quant deploy

Liam — quick update and decisions from our side after the triage window.

What we are doing now (decided):
- Immediate, targeted rollback of the quant profile for Veridian’s deployment: q5-uint8 -> q4-int8. Rollback scheduled at 00:00 UTC (2026-12-12) with canary and phased ramp (expected ~10 minute window).
- We will not change model weights (v5.1 stays) so inference semantics remain aligned.
- Compensation: Naomi has approved a 25% credit for the affected day and an expedited postmortem.
- Internal mitigation: Marissa will lead deeper calibration and a conservative q5 revalidation checklist before any further rollouts.

INC-9821 will be updated with final RCA and action items. Post-rollback we’ll run the replay for 2 hours and share a complete profiling report and communication draft for your review.

Apologies for the disruption — we take this seriously and will prioritize avoiding recurrence. Please flag any immediate constraints to the rollback window.

Best,
Irene Choi
Principal Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
